name: SDN-AP Propagator
description: General-perturbations propagation of whole catalogs: SGP4 and SGP4XP (the US Space Force SGP4-XP theory, clean-room), batch and structure-of-arrays, bounded memory, random access in time; an AP state depends on the order of requests, by up to 12.7 mm at 500 km, 0.18 m at 300 km and 0.29 m on a low orbit at e 0.05 with tesseral degree 31 (SPEC 9; test/kernel-cost.mjs --diff).
